exposure: Very small for gestational age neonates (<5th percentile)
Small for gestational age neonates (<10th percentile)
Induction of labor with prostaglandin E2 ± oxytocin and/or mechanical dilation ± oxytocin
Induction of labor with misoprostol ± oxytocin
finding: Misoprostol induction of labor in small for gestational age neonates does not appear to increase the risk of adverse outcomes compared to alternative agents.
mod_finding: The study investigated outcomes for small-for-gestational-age neonates induced with misoprostol compared to other cervical ripening agents but did not specifically focus on mode of delivery.
